title: Introduction and overview — Porsche 356 (1948-1965)
description: Introduction and overview of the Porsche 356 (1948-1965): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Porsche 356 was the company's first production car, built from 1948 to 1965 in Gmünd, Austria, then Stuttgart. Its rear-mounted air-cooled flat-four and light weight made it a giant-killer in racing. About 76,000 were built across pre-A, A, B, and C versions, laying the template for the 911.
